_comment_features: 7-frame only, flat directory structure, state management
_comment_source_dirs: Source directories to scan for video files. Independent of categories. Add/edit via: python video_manager.py
_comment_videos: Video list populated by 'Rescan file list' in video_manager.py. Categories assigned interactively.
_comment_category_weights: How patches are distributed across categories during generation.

validation.note: Validation GT is manually copied to val/720/GT/ and val/720_169/GT/

_comment_random_seed: Optional: Set random seed for reproducible patch generation. Omit for random behavior.
_comment_timeouts: Optional: Timeouts for FFmpeg operations (in seconds)
